questions.question: Which ID documents are accepted?
questions.reference: A valid government-issued photo ID: passport, Aadhaar card or driver's licence, not expired on the joining date, submitted at least 10 days before joining.

questions.question: How recent does my address proof need to be?
questions.reference: Address proof must be dated within the last 3 months: a utility bill, rental agreement or Aadhaar card.

questions.question: Do I need to submit a PAN card?
questions.reference: Yes. Employees based in India must submit a PAN card for payroll tax registration at least 10 days before joining.

questions.question: What do I need for salary credit?
questions.reference: India-based employees submit a cancelled cheque or bank letter at least 5 days before joining.

questions.question: Do I need a relieving letter?
questions.reference: Lateral hires at grade G3 and above must provide a relieving or experience letter from their previous employer at least 7 days before joining. Interns and G1-G2 are exempt.

questions.question: Which file formats can I upload?
questions.reference: PDF, JPG or PNG files under 10 MB. Scans must be legible with all four corners visible. Password-protected PDFs are not accepted.

questions.question: Why would a document be rejected?
questions.reference: If it is expired, illegible, the wrong file type, or the name or date of birth does not match the offer details. Re-submit within 2 working days.

questions.question: How long does background verification take?
questions.reference: BGV starts once identity, address, education and experience documents are accepted and typically takes 3-5 working days.

questions.question: Can I get my laptop before BGV is complete?
questions.reference: Yes. The laptop and email can be provisioned before BGV completes; system access is granted only after BGV is complete.

questions.question: What laptop will I get as an engineer?
questions.reference: Engineering roles receive a MacBook Pro with 16GB or more.

questions.question: When do I get GitHub and AWS access?
questions.reference: Engineering gets GitHub, Jira and AWS non-production access after BGV and the information security acknowledgement. Production access needs separate manager approval after 30 days.

questions.question: What will my corporate email address be?
questions.reference: firstname.lastname@azentio.com; login details are shared to the personal email the day before joining.

questions.question: What time should I arrive on my first day?
questions.reference: Report to reception at 9:30 AM local time on the joining date and bring the original photo ID.

questions.question: Where is the Bengaluru office?
questions.reference: Azentio Tech Park, Outer Ring Road, Bellandur.

questions.question: What is the dress code?
questions.reference: Business casual.

questions.question: When must I acknowledge the information security policy?
questions.reference: In the onboarding portal at least 1 day before joining, and before access to production systems or customer data.

questions.question: How quickly must I report a phishing email?
questions.reference: Report suspected phishing or security incidents to security@azentio.com within 1 hour.

questions.question: Do I have to declare gifts?
questions.reference: Gifts above INR 5,000 (USD 60) must be declared to HR.

questions.question: When is the code of conduct acknowledgement due?
questions.reference: It must be acknowledged in the onboarding portal on or before the first day.

questions.question: What is on the day-one agenda?
questions.reference: 9:30 badge and desk allocation, 10:00 HR orientation, 12:30 team lunch with the manager, 14:00 laptop handover and account setup with IT.
